How do I add a banner or background?

It changes depending on the sizes, positioning, etc. of the images you want to use, but here are some basics to get you started.

The banner:

#header {
background: url(http://www.whereswaldo.com/m/images/maps_troy.jpg) repeat-x;
display: block;
margin-left: auto;
margin-right: auto;
height: 250px; }

Adjust the height according to the size of the image you link.

The background:

body {
background: url(http://farm4.static.flickr.com/3179/2977148318_3b02ca194d.jpg) no-repeat fixed center center;}

To change just background color: 

body {
background-color: #FFFFFF;}

Change the "#FFFFFF" to any hex color you desire, here is a link to a good color picker.
